name: Influencer Lifestyle
tagline: Scroll-stopping content for your feed and stories.
description: A month of content in one batch: outfit-of-the-day street shots, sunny brunches, hotel balconies, flower markets, rooftop golden hour, pastel walls, matcha cafés and nights out. Feed-ready 4:5 frames plus vertical 9:16 shots for stories and reels covers.
